system.description: Sorcerer Base List 9.1 - Flesh Destruction. Attack spells that sprain, break, wither and disrupt a target's limbs, organs and flesh.

A random part of a random limb is sprained. If it is part of a leg: movement is cut by 25%, melee and missile attacks are modified by -10. If it is part of an arm, melee and missile attacks are modified by -20.
A random limb is in intense pain. For a leg, the target cannot walk (target may crawl at 10% of his normal movement); for an arm, that arm cannot be used.

The bones and tissues of the target's body are disrupted as if the target had fallen a long distance. If the target fails his RR by 1-10, he takes an 'A' Impact critical; by 11-20, a 'B'; by 21-30, a 'C'; by 31-40, a 'D'; by more than 41, an 'E'.
One of the target's joints locks. Target suffers the effects of Limb Pain. A moving target with a locked leg falls. A target with a locked arm drops anything he is carrying.
A random limb is broken. A broken arm is useless. One broken leg cuts movement by 50% and combat is modified by -75.
As Touch of Disruption, except range is 20'.

Target's skin will flake and peel all over his body. There is no tactical penalty, but target's Appearance is lowered by -50 (to a minimum of 1). Lasts until dispelled and 1 month passes. Magical healing could reduce this time.
As Touch of Disruption, except range is 50'.

One of the target's ears (random) is disrupted. His hearing is at 50% of normal until cured. This results in a -50 penalty to Awareness/Searching and Awareness/Senses skills involving only hearing (or -5 for Alertness skill); -25 to such skills involving hearing and other senses (or -3 for Alertness skill). If this spell is cast upon the same ear twice, the target is deaf in that ear.

One of the target's limbs (random) will wither and die. Target loses 5% of the use of the limb per day; when the total reaches 100%, the limb falls off. Can be cured through circulation and nerve repair spells up to the 80% point, then it must be regenerated. If the limb is a leg, movement is reduced by half the percentage lost. If the limb is an arm, combat suffers a -1 penalty per 1% withered.
As Rupture Ear, except an eye is affected (as well as visual perception).
One of the target's lungs collapses. He is at 50% of normal for all activity until the lung is repaired.
As Limb Death, except a random muscle is affected (not muscle organs, e.g., not the heart).
As Limb Death, except a random bone (not part of spine or skull) gradually disintegrates.
One of the Black Channel I spells may be used.
As any single 10th level or lower spell on this list, except with a range of 300'.
As any single lower level spell, except it may be cast upon as many targets as the caster has levels.
The target's bones will gradually petrify; a loss of activity (as in Limb Death) occurs due to loss of blood production.
As Black Channel I, except one of the Black Channel II spells may be used.
As Touch of Disruption, except range is 300' and always delivers an 'E' Impact critical if the target fails to resist.
As Black Channel I, except one of the Black Channel III spells may be used.
